stem: What inference about horses can the reader make based on the section “I See What You’re Saying”?

options.label: A
options.text: Horses can make a limited number of facial expressions.

options.label: B
options.text: Horses become suspicious around unfamiliar people.

options.label: C
options.text: Horses can tell how people are feeling by looking at them.

options.label: D
options.text: Horses use a special sense to understand human moods.
